description: Hand-authored ground truth for rust-reqwest synthetic fixture. Three reqwest URL-extraction shapes (literal, const, format!()) each produce one HTTP_CALLS edge to the matching axum handler.
notes: Each module exercises one of the three URL-extraction shapes Phase C1 makes durable. The URLs are absolute (https://...) but the path-only portion (/api/orders, /api/users, /api/items) is what matchAndLink uses to pair caller↔route. The fixture is split into src/callers/ and src/server/ subdirectories so matchAndLink's sameService filter (strip-2 directory comparison) classes them as cross-service. The to_qn_suffix lands on `handle_*` (the actual handler functions) because Phase D1 (PR #257) reworked matchAndLink to look up handlers via RouteHandler.HandlerRef + crate-locality bias, instead of pointing every edge at the route-declaring function (build_router).
